step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture shows an automated AWS account and network vending system. The User interacts with an ITSM tool (ServiceNow), which triggers Control Tower in the Root account to provision accounts. Service Catalog then deploys VPCs into the Vended account. A Transit Gateway in the Vended account connects to a central Transit Gateway in the Network account.
